# AvaScry — Magic: The Gathering Visual & Semantic Knowledge Corpus

> AvaScry is an AI-native semantic knowledge corpus and visual engine for Magic: The Gathering. Powered by 4096-dimensional Qwen 8B vector embeddings across 38,000+ Oracle cards, sub-millisecond card rendering, comprehensive rules layers, errata history, and format legalities.
>
> Full Deep Knowledge Corpus: https://avascry.com/llms-full.txt

## Corpus Metadata & Versioning
- **Corpus-Version:** 1.0
- **Markdown-Schema:** 1.0
- **Similarity-Model:** Qwen-8B-4096d
- **Update-Frequency:** Daily
- **Canonical-Host:** https://avascry.com

## Machine Ingestion Guarantees
- All `/printing/*.md` endpoints begin with structured YAML frontmatter.
- All `/similar/*.md` endpoints provide 4096-dimensional nearest neighbors in ranked order.
- All rules and errata align with the official Magic Comprehensive Rules.
- Deterministic schema: Exact Oracle texts, Mana Values, Power/Toughness, and Legalities.

## AI Agent Integration & Multimodal Endpoints

AI agents, LLMs, Discord bots, and developers can retrieve token-efficient Markdown payloads or structured JSON across all surfaces:

- **Card Printings:**
  - Markdown: `https://avascry.com/printing/<card-slug>-<set>.md`
  - JSON: `https://avascry.com/printing/<card-slug>-<set>.json`
- **4096-Dim Neural Synergies:**
  - Markdown: `https://avascry.com/similar/<card-slug>.md`
  - JSON: `https://avascry.com/similar/<card-slug>.json`
- **Artist Portfolios:**
  - Markdown: `https://avascry.com/artist/<artist-slug>.md`
  - JSON: `https://avascry.com/artist/<artist-slug>.json`
- **Sets Directory:**
  - Markdown: `https://avascry.com/sets.md`
  - JSON: `https://avascry.com/set/<set-code>.json`
- **Cockatrice Desktop Simulator Database:** `https://avascry.com/set/<set-code>/cockatrice.xml`
- **Live RSS 2.0 Syndication Feeds:**
  - Latest Sets Feed: `https://avascry.com/feed/sets.xml`
  - Latest Rulings Feed: `https://avascry.com/feed/rulings.xml`
- **Raw 4096-Dim Neural Vector Embeddings (Qwen 8B):** `https://avascry.com/vector/<card-slug>.json`

## Unified Discord Identity & Network Single Sign-On (SSO)
AvaScry operates as a unified multi-game card network spanning Magic: The Gathering, Star Wars: Unlimited, Dominion, and Necromunda.

- **Unified Network SSO**: A single Discord OAuth session authenticates users across all game subdomains (`avascry.com`, `swu.avascry.com`, `dominion.avascry.com`, `necromunda.avascry.com`).
- **Discord-Exclusive Privacy**: Zero passwords, zero email collection, and no credential fatigue. User identity, saved Commander brews, and collection state synchronize across all devices via Discord OAuth.
- **Discord Community & Pod Integration**: Designed for tabletop Discord pods with 1-click deck sharing, card embeds, and community errata lookup.
- **Bot & API Readiness**: Clean token-efficient Markdown (`.md`) and JSON (`.json`) endpoints power Discord bots for `/card`, `/rules`, and `/deck` lookups.

## Retrieval Examples

### Content Negotiation Headers (Preferred)
```bash
# Fetch Token-Efficient Markdown (for LLM reasoning & crawling)
curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://avascry.com/printing/combat-research-dmu

# Fetch Structured JSON (for Discord bots, tools & apps)
curl -H "Accept: application/json" https://avascry.com/printing/combat-research-dmu
```

### Direct Markdown & JSON URLs
```bash
# Markdown
curl https://avascry.com/printing/combat-research-dmu.md
curl https://avascry.com/similar/combat-research.md

# JSON API
curl https://avascry.com/printing/combat-research-dmu.json
curl https://avascry.com/similar/combat-research.json
curl https://avascry.com/artist/rebecca-guay.json
curl https://avascry.com/set/dmu.json
```

### Python Retrieval
```python
import httpx
client = httpx.Client()
resp = client.get("https://avascry.com/printing/sol-ring-lea.md")
print(resp.text)
```

## Preferred Crawl Sequence for Autonomous Agents
1. `https://avascry.com/llms.txt` (This manifest)
2. `https://avascry.com/rules.md` (Rules mechanics, continuous layers & priority)
3. `https://avascry.com/legalities.md` (Format constraints & banlists)
4. `https://avascry.com/sitemap.html` (Complete category crawl web)
5. `https://avascry.com/similar/<slug>.md` (4096-dim synergy graph)
6. `https://avascry.com/printing/<slug>.md` (Canonical card documents)

## Crawling & Usage Policy
- AI Search, Ingestion & Training: Allowed (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Anthropic-AI, PerplexityBot, Applebot, Amazonbot, Googlebot, Bingbot)
- Permitted Routes: `/`, `/printing/*`, `/similar/*`, `/artist/*`, `/set/*`, `/sets`, `/rules.md`, `/legalities.md`, `/commander`
- Restricted Routes: `/api/*`, `/auth/*`, `/dashboard`
